map.内梅罗综合指数法环境质量评价 使用指南: Nemerow Index Environmental Quality Assessment User Guide
map.算法：单项指数 Pi = 实测 Ci / 标准 Si；平均指数 Pavg = Σ: Algorithm: single index Pi = measured Ci / standard Si; average index Pavg = sum(Pi)/n; comprehensive index P = sqrt((Pmax^2 + Pavg^2)/2). Grading: P<0.7 clean (I), ...
map.多要素评价：同时录入水质、土壤、噪声等若干指标的实测值与标准值，得综合污染指数: Multi-factor assessment: enter the measured and standard values of several indicators such as water quality, soil and noise at once to get a comprehensive pollution index
map.溯源定位：由最大单项指数锁定首要污染因子，指导治理优先级: Source tracing: identify the primary pollution factor from the largest single index to guide remediation priorities
map.达标判定：按综合指数分级（清洁/轻/中/重污染）出具评价结论: Compliance judgment: issue an assessment conclusion graded by the comprehensive index (clean / light / moderate / heavy pollution)
map.但若关键因子缺失会使 Pmax 失真，结论仅供参考，正式评价应补全监测数据: But if a key factor is missing, Pmax will be distorted; the conclusion is for reference only, and a formal assessment should complete the monitoring data
map.为什么用内梅罗法而非简单平均？: Why use the Nemerow method rather than a simple average?
map.内梅罗法用平方和开方突出最大单项污染（Pmax），避免平均稀释掉突出超标因子，更: The Nemerow method uses the root of the sum of squares to highlight the largest single pollutant (Pmax), preventing the average from diluting an outstanding exceedance and better identifying the primary pollution source; it is the common practice in the technical guidelines for environmental impact assessment.
map.某指标实测值缺失怎么处理？: What if the measured value of an indicator is missing?
map.缺失或标准值≤0 的该指标不参与平均（跳过）。但若关键因子缺失会使 Pmax 失: An indicator with a missing value or a standard value of 0 or less is skipped and excluded from the average. But if a key factor is missing, Pmax will be distorted; the conclusion is for reference only, and a formal assessment should complete the monitoring data.
